watchlist_releases.name: v1.5.0
watchlist_releases.body: This releases adds supports of dynamic visual textures, which is useful for a wide range of applications from animated screens but to painting. Besides, support of third-party rendering backends has been greatly improved by providing a efficient interoperability layer with a stable API and protocol. Finally, the cost of calling setters between steps has been dramatically reduced by refreshing stale derived quantities lazily only as they are read. ### Breaking / Changing * [FEATURE] Add debug view mode and dynamic vertices of visual geoms. (@duburcqa) (#3849) * [MISC] Interpret unset or zero effort in URDF as unbounded. (@jih0-kim) (#3503) ### New Features Add support of dynamic visual texture. (@Milotrince) (#3828⁠) ### Bug fixes * Fix polar decomposition returning a reflection for matrices of negative det. (@duburcqa) (#3856) * Fix decimating a mesh with duplicate faces. (@realquantumcookie) (#3491) * Fix liquid scenes hanging on macOS in the debug view. (@duburcqa) (#3860) * Fix the gradient of the orientation set on a fixed-base entity. (@duburcqa) (#3867) * Fix debug mode leaking its settings of torch into later sessions. (@duburcqa) (#3869) * Fix mesh caches breaking across dependency versions. (@Milotrince) (#3672) * Fix animate mistiming frames and drop moviepy. (@Milotrince) (#3858) * Fix crashes on arrays loade
